main_text.l: dicat se jurare pro se & hæredibus suis.
lem quæ est in conscientia necesse est esse
personalem; sicut est sua cuiusque consci-
entia propria, & quæ non potest transire
in aliam personam: at obligatio temporalis
cum possit transire ad aliam personam,
ex æquitate rei, non vi juramenti.
ejus cui juratur: An qui juravit aliquid ali-
cui facturum, eo defuncto obligetur id
facere hæredi ejus vel successori? Re-
se facturum ipsi aut hæredi. Obligari
etiam censendus est, etsi non fit expres-
si quis Subditus aut Miles juret fidelita-tem

page.notes: The space in "si quis" is very narrow in the scan ("fiquis" as printed); transcribed as "si quis". The catchword "tem" is the start of the word completed from "fidelita-" and is taken as the catchword. The right edge shows cut-off text of the neighbouring page and was left out. The marginal note "Casus 26" is read from the italic left-margin entry; the "26" may be a section reference and is copied as printed.
